Title: [Reissue][Response] Verify the four V2 Reissue endpoints are deployed on the target host and answer for the target supplier.
Capabilities / Test Data: RI-Search / RI-Review / RI-Commit / RI-Lookup = the four V2 Reissue endpoints (Reissue Search, Validation/Review, Reissue, Reissue Lookup); paths and field names TBD until the contract is shared (Analysis Q1). One ticketed PNR from TC-RI-CAP-03. Minimal valid body per endpoint.
Preconditions: Reissue contract shared with QA. Target host and supplier/selector agreed.
Steps / Endpoint Chain: 1. POST RI-Search with the PNR and a date change. 2. POST RI-Lookup with the same PNR. 3. Record status, body, response time.
Expected Result: Neither call returns 404, 405 or 409 OperationNotSupported. RI-Search returns HTTP 200 (options or an explicit no-availability result).
Notes: Type: Functional | Technique: EP | Gate G1 - needs the Reissue contract (paths/field names); behaviour-level assertions only until then. Suite entry gate. If it fails, mark every G1/G2 row BLOCKED for this host.

Capabilities / Test Data: Routes from Resources/Supplier Routes.md: MCT-DXB, AMD-CAI, AUH-ADL. 1 ADT, Economy, D+21. Fixture re-validated with validate-testdata-search.
Preconditions: Staging host only (never production, SPEC §2.9 shouldSkipBookingInProduction).
Steps / Endpoint Chain: 1. V2 Search -> FareConfirm -> AddPassenger -> Book. 2. Retrieve. 3. Void. 4. Retrieve again.
Expected Result: Book HTTP 200 with pnr/bookingToken; Retrieve shows tickets[] populated; Void HTTP 200; the post-void Retrieve shows the voided state.
Notes: Type: Functional | Technique: EP | Gate G0 - runnable now on existing endpoints. Proves the arrange chain and the cleanup path (Q22b: clean up with Void). If tickets[] is null right after Book, retry Retrieve before declaring a failure (SPEC §2.9 async ticketing).
